items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: 14 piece band and Ivy Anderson... we had three singers.

ctx.x: Was that -- it was a 14 piece band plus Ivy.
14 piece band and Ivy Anderson. Then they carried Snake Hips Tucker and Bessie Dudley and a couple of people like that. Then later on they carried three or four -- we had three singers.
You had known Ivy at the Apex in Los Angeles. Had you known anybody else who was in the band before you joined, or was Ivy the only person you had ever met before?

items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: she fit perfectly with the band her voice was of the sultry type that fit the band perfectly.

ctx.x: Do you remember any of the --
Did she play in the Apex Club?
